For anyone just starting into Linux, or curious, I think a good way to get familiar with the world of linux is to listen to some linux podcasts. Some of them are actually quite entertaining. The most popular out there would be The Linux Action Show followed by Linux Unplugged from Jupiter Broadcasting. Ubuntu Podcast and Linux Luddites are also fairly popular. There are other good ones out there too.

It's not like it's all boring technical discussions. They tend to be entertaining coverage of news and topics related to linux. Some of the shows are hosted by and/or have regular guests that are developers behind linux distros and software. How often do you hear from and get to know the people actually writing code behind, say, Windows?

Sure, some of the stuff they talk about may go over your head, but it can still be entertaining to listen to. And like watching a foreign language channel, after a while you eventually start learning the language. You also get to understand the appeal and appreciate the community atmosphere behind much of the open source world.
